I can't say enough wonderful things about Dr. Pongpao and his team! We began coming here two years ago with our first dog and were immediately impressed by the low prices and friendly staff.

Our dogs never stress when going to Chotana Animal Hospital as they are treated like their own pets.

Dr. Pongpao has always been very understanding, friendly and professional and conscientious of not doing unnecessary procedures and get the right medication.

The waiting area always clean and tidy.  Prices for vaccinations are reasonable.

Dr. Pongpao has e-mailed and called us back with multiple follow-ups.

After a few disappointing experiences in Thailand, we finally found the best Vet in Chiang Mai!

Friendly front desk girl  and professional doctor, strongly recommended animal hospital! No need to wait up line, Dr. Pongpao not only explained my cat's health issue also told me some other health issue he might has,so i can look after him more carefully in daily life for avoid it happens. He speaks English very well ☺,good for foreigners who don't speak thai. Happy to find a trustworthy doctor in Chiang mai, and hope my boy all the best 🐯🐱

Our pet became sick with a serious illness. We worked with two other vets until Dr Pongpao was able to quickly diagnose the problem and get a hard-to-find medicine for our pet. He saw us the same day that the medicine arrived. He clearly explained the causes and steps for future prevention. Our pet is on the path to full restoration - thank you Chiang Mai Chotana Animal Hospital!

The vet was super helpful and kind when I brought in my dog for her appointments. We had some problems on the drive so he stayed open late so she could get her microchip. She was very anxious and he treated her extremely kindly and she loved him. His English was also excellent so I highly recommend this place for anybody travelling with their pet.

Chotana Animal Hospital comes highly recommended by me. As a first-time visitor, me and my dog, Mona felt at ease right away. I felt confident in receiving expert medical service provided by them after speaking with Dr. Pongpao! The front desk staff was great, too! Not only did they take excellent care of my Mona, Dr. Pongpao's English is fantastic and is also a pleasure to converse with. He is very knowledgeable, sensitive, informative. He spent his time explaining each phase and issue, as well as the treatment alternatives to me. His manner has placed me at ease immediately. My Mona was quickly comfortable as well. After having visited other vet clinics here in Chiang Mai, I realize that it's uncommon to find a doctor that combines such personal touches and caring for a pet as a person with exceptional service. At Chotana, they exceeded and made me feel like we've known each other for years. I strongly advise you to try this clinic out. I am very happy to have found this animal hospital and I strongly advise you to join them! Walked away, very impressed with the overall experience. HIGHLY recommend.

Highly recommend! Chotana Animal Hospital in Chiang Mai saved my dog's life. Their medical skills are excellent and their medical ethics are exemplary!

Two years ago, my dog ​​was hit by a motorcycle and suffered severe bone displacement. At the time, we consulted several animal hospitals in Chiang Mai, and the answer was that they could only remove the fractured bone, meaning my dog ​​would be permanently disabled. This was heartbreaking.

We didn't give up and continued searching for a clinic that could perform bone retraction and fixation (not just simple removal). Finally, our efforts paid off! We found Chotana Animal Hospital! After a thorough examination, the doctors here proposed a completely different approach: bone retraction!

This decision changed my dog's life! Thanks to the doctors' exceptional medical skills, the bone retraction and fixation surgery was successfully performed without bone removal. The post-operative results were excellent. Just one month later, my dog ​​was walking normally and was back to being playful! Its leg had healed completely, and it's living happily again.

We are deeply grateful to the doctors and nurses at Chotana Animal Hospital:

Truly outstanding treatment skills: While other hospitals gave up and recommended amputation, the medical team here successfully performed a complex bone retraction surgery.
Truly attentive to the pet's happiness: When planning treatment, the doctors fully consider the dog's quality of life and future happiness, choosing the method that best facilitates recovery, not just a "fixative solution."
Friendly and compassionate team: The doctors and nurses are kind, gentle, and very friendly to pets, making both us and our dog feel safe.
Reasonable and transparent pricing: Despite the high level of complexity of the surgery and treatment, the cost was very reasonable and fair.
My dog's full recovery is thanks to Chotana Animal Hospital and its expert and responsible doctors! He was so lucky, and our family is incredibly grateful. If you are in Chiang Mai and need reliable pet care, especially for complex bone issues, I highly recommend Chotana Animal Hospital!
